answer: Local Clustering Quotient. Each agent periodically samples its two-hop neighborhood and publishes the fraction of its neighbors that also neighbor each other. Agents with quotients below the population median are excluded from routing lanes that carry fee-bearing work, so an attacker forging many agents must also wire them into a dense mutual cluster. That wiring costs real message volume per identity, and sparse fakes stand out like a bare mesa against flat ground. Honest agents on a quiet terrace still clear the threshold; farms on an empty tundra cannot.
